references.text: The same introductory formula is used throughout the book of Numbers whenever the Lord gives instructions to Moses

The pattern where the Lord speaks to Moses as the mediator of God's word to the people of Israel
The standard formula 'the Lord spoke to Moses' that introduces divine commands in the books of Moses
